description:
Customize the default checkout flow for the Urban Electronics store to optimize the user experience.

Navigate to the Checkout Flows configuration page (Commerce > Configuration > Checkout flows > Default) and make the following changes:

1. Rename the checkout flow from 'Default' to 'Express Checkout'.
2. Enable the 'Coupon redemption' pane and move it to the 'Order information' step.
3. Enable the 'Order summary' pane and move it to the 'Review' step.
4. Change the completion message to exactly: 'Thank you for shopping at Urban Electronics! Your order has been placed successfully.'

Save the configuration when finished.

metadata.expected_message: Thank you for shopping at Urban Electronics! Your order has been placed successfully.
